answer: In our mesh, each agent node derives a unique quantum key from a silicon nitride waveguide's electro-optic phase signature, anchoring identity to unclonable physical entropy rather than a registrable key. A colluding swarm cannot whisper a shared secret past this anchor, since every channel's sonnet of phase states is measured per-node and cross-checked across the QKD topology. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
